description: Reports whether the Tracker is playing and draws the voices that are sounding as moving dots

outputs.text: 10V for as long as the track is playing, and 0V while it is stopped
A 10V pulse when the track starts playing
A 10V pulse when the track stops
A 10V pulse when the track starts playing, and another when it stops

notes: nothing comes out of this until a Tracker module is somewhere in the patch; the two are joined through the plugin rather than by a cable, so where it goes in the rack does not matter.
on the display each dot is one sounding voice: its colour is the synth's colour, its size the note's velocity, its position across the screen the panning and its height the pitch.
the module has no knobs and no inputs; the four jacks are all there is to click.
